notes: Canonical job-stage vocabulary for the Gene Synthesis Platform. Read by the Python bridge (python_tools/job_log.py) and by the frontend (src/lib/stages.ts) so the two never drift. Stage 0 is where a new job enters the pipeline; stages 1-12 are the pipeline in order. The 'timeline' values are the BBI turnaround times from the in-house progress workbook's Stages sheet. Lifecycle states that sit OUTSIDE the pipeline (cancelled, moved to Sg, shipped) are NOT stages and are not listed here - the Job Log filters them as categories.
